correctness.rationale: Computed one-step conditional mean E[V_k|F_{k-1}]=(1-2p_k)Q_{k-1}, so a_k=prod(1-2p_j/(m+j)) and M_k=Q_k/a_k is a martingale with increments D_k=(V_k-(1-2p_k)Q_{k-1})/[(m+k)a_k]. Since p_n->0, a_n and a_n^-1 are positive slowly varying and a_n^-1=n^{o(1)}, making sum Var(D_k) finite and giving L2 terminal convergence. Block increments sqrt(n) a_n sum_{k~nu} D_k have bracket ->(1-Q_infinity^2)(1/r-1/t), and jumps O(n^-1/2), satisfying the martingale stable FCLT with a Brownian independent of terminal history. Truncating future at nR has L2 remainder <=4n a_n^2 sum_{k>nR}1/((m+k)^2 a_k^2)->4/R by Karamata; send R->infinity to obtain the backward Brownian covariance 1/max(s,t), uniformly for r<=t<=T. Uniform slow variation replaces a_n with a_floor(nt). Convergence at t=0 is correctly excluded. The logarithmic product criterion gives a_infinity>0 iff sum p_k/(m+k)<infinity; divergence makes Q_infinity=0. Independently checked exact conditional expectation/second-moment recurrence across 40 finite urn distributions (four seeds, two nonconstant schedules). Finite checks establish no weak convergence.

value.rationale: Gives a complete path-level second-order law around the random terminal martingale drift for arbitrary deterministic reversal probabilities tending to zero, with an inverse-time Brownian covariance and a phase distinction between persistent random composition and erased memory. This is a motivated stochastic limit distinct from first-order convergence and fixed-parameter elephant fluctuation laws.

final_claim: For any deterministic p_n in [0,1] with p_n->0 and initially both colours, the terminal-centered imbalance process sqrt(n)(Q_floor(nt)-a_floor(nt)M_infinity) converges stably on [r,T] (r>0) to sqrt(1-Q_infinity^2) B(1/t), independent Brownian conditional on full urn history; conditional covariance equals (1-Q_infinity^2)/max(s,t).
limitations: Only deterministic p_n->0, seeded two-colour single-addition urn, terminal unobservable centering and compact positive time intervals; no rate or origin-time limit. Gava–Rezende 2021 full text inaccessible; a general earlier correlated-Bernoulli invariance theorem might overlap. Authorized Oxford retrieval reported vpn_disconnected; no bypass attempted.
